answer: Miscellaneous >> Islamic Names Question ID: 9636 Country: MU Title: Are both these names right Zaakirah and Zakeerah? The former means one who remembers Allah, does the latter one means striking? Jazakumullah Question: Are both these names right Zaakirah and Zakeerah? The former means one who remembers Allah, does the latter one means striking? Jazakumullah Answer ID: 9636 Posted on: Aug 30, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 2284/2079=D/1429) Zakeerah is feminine form of Zakeer which means: one who remembers much, one having good memory. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
